content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for clock will not operate condition

steps.check: Check to see if fuse is blown.
steps.action: Locate trouble and repair or replace fuse as necessary.

steps.check: Check to see if clock adjusting knob is binding in position and has failed to return.
steps.action: Repair if necessary or replace clock.

steps.check: Check to see if battery voltage is over 11V with no load.
Check to see if connector on clock side is loose or rusted.
Check to see if there is voltage at terminal B or connector or clock side.
Check to see if clock ground wire is loose or rusted.

content.description: Troubleshooting flowchart for clock loses or gains time condition

steps.check: Check amount of time the clock loses or gains per day or a week against the allowable error table.
Check to see if there is 11V–15V on terminal B of connector on clock side.
steps.action: Locate cause and repair, or recharge battery.
